subtasks.text: Note that most existing studies are exploratory in nature, heavily relying on local knowledge and using just one type of sensor.

guidance_text: GLOBAL_SUMMARY:

Most existing agricultural remote sensing studies are exploratory and rely on local knowledge, using only one type of sensor. This approach has limitations due to its narrow scope and lack of comprehensive data collection methods.

The video highlights the current practice of agricultural remote sensing, where studies are often limited by the use of single-sensor data and the dependence on local knowledge. These practices suggest a need for more standardized and comprehensive approaches to improve the accuracy and reliability of remote sensing data.
